text: A poet who cannot write and his young wife are restoring a country house where she glimpses [a heart beating inside the walls|images|the house and its rooms]. When a stranger and then his wife arrive uninvited, the poet welcomes them, and Mother soon finds [blood that will not stop dripping|images|blood] into the floor. Each wave of guests is ruder than the last, until a crowd of admirers pours in to [worship the poet|wants|fame and worship], [tearing the home apart|ending|the place is destroyed] around his pregnant wife.
